# Calorie
> A private, local-first food, water, and weight journal with transparent timing guidance. Optional Google or Apple sign-in can add private Cloudflare sync.

## Primary
- [Product overview](https://calorie.significanthobbies.com/index.md): Canonical Markdown summary of Calorie.
- [Privacy](https://calorie.significanthobbies.com/privacy/): Current privacy policy.
- [Support](https://calorie.significanthobbies.com/support/): Support and feedback.
- [TestFlight](https://calorie.significanthobbies.com/testflight/): Current beta availability.

## Product boundaries
- No social feed
- Not medical advice
- Default data is local-first; optional private cloud sync
- No App Store listing yet
